blogs.title: "Why One‑Bit Language Models Are the Next Frontier"
blogs.description: Explore how BitNet b1.58 reduces every model weight to merely -1, 0 or +1 while delivering performance equal to FP‑16 models—cutting memory usage, speeding up inference and slashing GPU power draw.

blogs.title: "Behind the Magic of Quantization in BitNet b1.58"
blogs.description: A lay‑person look at the absmean technique that forces all weights into ternary values, how this simple trick lets the network act as a dynamic filter thanks to its new zero‑weight option.

blogs.title: "From Theory to Numbers—BitNet b1.58 Matches Full Precision at Three Billion Parameters"
blogs.description: Delve into the study’s key findings showing that as soon as a model hits roughly 3 B parameters it matches the perplexity and zero‑shot performance of conventional FP‑16 transformers while still outpacing much larger full‑precision baselines.

blogs.title: "Speed Meets Efficiency—How BitNet Cuts Latency & Memory by Over Threefold"
blogs.description: Read how integer‑only matrix multiplications coupled with low‑bit activations reduce GPU RAM needs by more than three times and cut response time across all tested sizes—from dozens to hundreds of milliseconds faster.

blogs.title: "Powering AI With Less Energy—BitNet’s Arithmetic Saves Up To Seventy‑Times"
blogs.description: "See how eliminating floating‑point multiplications turns matrix multiplication into cheap integer additions and can shave down arithmetic energy usage by nearly one order of magnitude according to recent models.

blogs.title: "Beyond Business Value—What’s Next for One‑Bit LLMs"
blogs.description: "Learn what lies ahead for milked-down LLMs—from making Mixture‑of‑Experts models easier to host across chips, supporting longer context windows on less memory than before, all the way up to fully custom ASICs designed only for ternary arithmetic.
